headline: Mayor Mamdani signed COPA, giving qualified nonprofits first chance to buy about 2,100 covered buildings starting next November.
Oppenheimer signed for about 220,000 square feet at 32 Old Slip, moving its headquarters from 85 Broad Street.
Tishman sold the 110 East 16th Street development site near Union Square for $44.25 million.
Extell paid $18 million for 1190 Avenue of the Americas to expand its Ikea-anchored 574 Fifth Avenue tower site.
